mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are seeing 35 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall, and we are under a waning crescent moon.

Important updates for our commute, with pavement milling and patching occurring on Tuesday, November 10th, followed by paving on Wednesday, November 11th, near North Nine Mound Road and surrounding areas. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects for the Liberty Business Park during their upcoming December 7th meeting.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's also taking place today.
Regarding local safety, on October 23rd, officers contacted two 13-year-olds on prohibited eMotos, resulting in citations for their parents.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, Really Reese's, and head over to the store when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
